//: The demo's OpenID Connect settings, read by OIDCAppConfiguration.load(context). The defaults point at iya-sts on https://localhost:8081, which the emulator reaches through `adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081` (scripts/setup-emulator.sh), client oidc-caep-android-demo (register it with scripts/register-iya-sts-client.mjs). To use another provider without rebuilding, push a file with the same keys to /sdcard/Android/data/net.rcbj.caepdemo/files/oidc_configuration.json.
